description: This file defines a simulated test runner class that manages background execution of test runs, including starting, logging, finalizing, and canceling runs. It also includes a broadcast event structure and singleton access to the runner instance.

classes.name: BroadcastEvent
classes.description: A data class representing broadcast events with a type and payload.

classes.name: SimulatedRunner
classes.description: A class that simulates executing test runs asynchronously, with support for broadcasting status and logs, and cancellation.

methods.name: set_broadcaster
methods.description: Sets an optional callback function for broadcasting real-time events.

methods.name: _broadcast
methods.description: Internal method to send broadcast events if a broadcaster is configured.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a test run for background execution, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _finalize_thread
methods.description: Removes thread and stop flag entries after run completion.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Simulates the lifecycle of a test run, updating status, logs, and results, with deterministic behavior based on run ID.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Requests cancellation of an active test run.

methods.name: get_runner
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the simulated test runner.
